notes: 永恆主 is LCC's distinctive rendering of יְהוָה (YHWH); UNV uses 耶和華. H3068 attached to 永恆主.
上帝 is LCC's rendering of אֱלֹהִים; UNV uses 神. H0430 attached to 上帝.
{<WH0853>} kept implicit — neither UNV nor LCC has an explicit word for the direct object marker אֶת.
H4480 (מִן, 'from') attached to 地上 alongside H0127 (אֲדָמָה) — the Chinese 地上的 absorbs the prepositional meaning.
生氣 carries both H5397 (נִשְׁמַת, breath) and H2416 (חַיִּים, life) as a compound phrase.
LCC's 有生命的 rephrases UNV's 有靈的 but maps to the same H5315 (נֶפֶשׁ, soul/living being).
UNV's 名叫亞當 is an interpretive addition — the Hebrew הָאָדָם simply means 'the man' (H0120). LCC correctly omits it; no SN orphaned.
SN tag placed on 人 before footnote marker 【5】 to keep annotation on the word itself.
